purpose: Give every intelligent character a cheap shared sense of the emotional climate of the current region/chapter so dialogue and behavior can feel appropriate to peace, suspicion, fear, grief, war pressure or refuge.
runtime_rules: Every named NPC and ambient archetype is world-mood aware.
Mood may change dialogue selection, caution, social willingness and idle behavior, but never mandatory story outcomes.
Danger state may temporarily raise fear beyond the chapter baseline.
Weather may modify presentation but cannot overwrite story truth.
The system runs fully offline and uses no network service.
performance_rule: Resolve one compact chapter mood tag from local data and reuse it across NPCs; do not run a separate expensive world-state model per actor.
